body.p: Moskres. Long ago, there was the clan Moskres on the earth. [Their] arrows were furcated. One old man is sitting. The old man had two children. The elder brother hunted wild reindeers in the upper world. The younger brother sat [at] the Norilsk lakes, he caught fish. There came other Evenks, they killed the younger brother. They killed the younger brother and ate [him]: they ate the raw meat, the ate the fat. Those people ate and said: "Why has your son so few brain (?)?" The mother says: "We are hungering for seven years." The people chopped a tree off. They cut off a tree and said: "When the larch resin of the tree is new, then search(?)!" These people were seven people, one shaman. These people left forever (= died). Now it is the Karanto clan, these clans are Karanto.[KAY]: 'Ð²Ñ£ÐºÑ' - means here probably 'forever', then the sentence 'These people went away forever' means 'They died'.
